# GitHub Copilot Instructions

> This file redirects Copilot to the canonical agent instructions.

The canonical instruction set for this repository is **AGENTS.md** in the root.
Read it first — it covers architecture, dependency rules, naming conventions,
testing, and links to subdirectory-specific guides.

Key files:

- `AGENTS.md` — project-wide architecture, DDD/Hexagonal patterns, dependency rules, skills index
- `backend/AGENTS.md` — backend commands, pattern inventory, naming conventions, testing conventions, worked endpoint example
- `frontend/AGENTS.md` — frontend commands, MUI + CSS Modules styling rules, theme, routing, data fetching
- `backend/docs/patterns/` — 24-page DDD pattern reference (design philosophy, dependency hierarchy, all pattern specs with anti-patterns and naming rules)
- `CLAUDE.md` — migration naming conventions, backend module structure (Claude-specific additions)
